opening.argument: The speaker presents a beginner walkthrough of KuCoin, showing viewers how to deposit cryptocurrency and place an order in the trading interface. The referral link and exchange promotion are visible parts of that presentation, but neither establishes a deceptive promise, fraudulent identity, or concealed diversion of money or data. The speaker also advises viewers to research projects to reduce the risk of losing cryptocurrency. Taken together, the observable material supports an instructional investment-related presentation, not a fraudulent transaction.
